title: Live schema changes and backfills
brief: Move through compatible schema and caller states using expand, migrate and contract. Prove a backfill converged despite races and late rows, and define acceptance and return boundaries.

neighbouring_ownership.writes: Owns import mechanics outside a live compatibility protocol.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns PostgreSQL locks, rewrites and index validity.

title: Inside PostgreSQL
brief: Trace one connection and request through PostgreSQL processes, shared buffers, heap tuples and indexes. Explain tuple visibility, HOT updates and their physical limits so native plans and maintenance have a concrete physical setting.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns retained horizons and transaction-age maintenance.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns durability controls and crash drills.

title: PostgreSQL vacuum and transaction age
brief: Diagnose retained PostgreSQL versions, visibility and transaction-age risk before changing maintenance. Distinguish reusable space from bloat and file shrinkage; choose vacuum and related interventions from retained horizons and age evidence.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-architecture: Owns first visibility and HOT explanation.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns standby and slot retention policy.

title: PostgreSQL index methods and operators
brief: Choose a PostgreSQL access method and operator class from the operator’s meaning and data organisation. Compare B-tree, hash, GIN, GiST, SP-GiST and BRIN, and verify candidates, rechecks and write costs in native plans.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns concurrent builds, invalid indexes and native maintenance procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-text: Owns linguistic text retrieval and ranking.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-extensions: Owns specialised type and extension dependencies.
